latin: Ex praecedenti conclusione sciri potest cur Ouidius, in execratione in Ibin, postquam inuocauit numen quod terram regit et aquam, terram inuocat et Neptunnum.
translation: From the preceding conclusion it can be known why Ovid, in his curse against Ibis, after invoking the deity that rules the earth and the water, invokes the earth and Neptune.
